name: @kachizaka/design-system
description: Kachizaka's own design system, built on @krizaka/ui, @krizaka/icons, @krizaka/tokens and @krizaka/fonts: what is specific to a sports league — the team crest (a deterministic, generated, free identity for any team name) and the sport glyphs. Anything another product could reuse goes to krizaka-ui.
